rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

artistic_choices: Lower body deliberately cropped because source specifies head and wings, not quadruped/humanoid body plan.
Fully opaque dark mantle is editorial modest clothing; no crown or weapon inferred from prince rank.
Tight low angle, feather motion and dust create menace without undocumented giant scale; neutral shadow backdrop because no setting claimed.
